faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing company in Bangalore for a clinic?
faqs.a: Look for proven performance, strong client relationships and real business impact in healthcare. Ask whether results are reported as walk-ins, not just leads, and how no-shows are handled. Check that every ad carries the doctor's registration details, as the NMC guidelines require.

faqs.q: Why do Bangalore clinics lose patients between booking and arrival?
faqs.a: Busy schedules and traffic can make it easy to forget or drop an appointment. Without confirmation and reminder messages, a booked slot can become a no-show. Clinics running a reminder sequence typically see a 15–25% improvement in show-up rate within 60 days.

faqs.q: Should Bangalore clinics advertise near offices or near homes?
faqs.a: Often both. Weekday visits may come from people working nearby, while weekend visits may come from residents. Separate campaigns for office hubs and residential areas show which patients actually arrive, so spend can follow walk-ins rather than clicks.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing front desk team in Bangalore?
faqs.a: Yes. Whether calls are answered by your front desk or by our agents, we measure and improve how enquiries become bookings. Calls are scored on a 100-point scale, and your team receives weekly coaching on what to change.

faqs.q: Can clinics in Bangalore offer free consultations in their ads?
faqs.a: No. Since 6 October 2026, the NMC guidelines bar free consultation or check-up campaigns, discounts, packages and limited-time offers in medical advertising. Clinics can still advertise factual details such as facilities, timings, specialist qualifications and standard consultation charges.
